_doc: Easter eggs and small landmarks. Placed deterministically per district (story/eggs.gd). trigger: interact (press E), near (walk up), scoop_near (scoop junk nearby, or press E), clean (surfaces when its hex is clean, then E), night (E at night), chain (several parts: parts > 1). Found eggs are global (flags.egg_<id>): rewards are given once, and the egg stays in the world as a landmark you can still poke. reward: cubes / trinkets / seeds. Hub 0 (Old Town) gets the 'starter' eggs; other districts get a seeded pick of 9.

eggs.name: Duck on Duty
eggs.lore: A rubber duck standing guard on a hydrant. A whole container of them spilled at the old port; this one walked inland.
eggs.toast: QUACK. The duck seems to know things.

eggs.name: The Last Jukebox
eggs.lore: The diner's jukebox only plays when it hears work being done. The cook said it was 'motivational'.
eggs.toast: The jukebox wakes up and plays a music-box waltz for the workers.

eggs.name: The Crew Mural
eggs.lore: The last cleanup crew painted themselves on a wall before the Ledger paused them. They really meant to come back.
eggs.toast: A mural of the old cleaning crew. 'WE'LL BE BACK AFTER LUNCH.'

eggs.name: Gnome Patrol
eggs.lore: Five garden gnomes, each facing a different street. A Maker kid's sign said they were 'on patrol'. They still are.
eggs.toast: All five gnomes found. They turn, very slowly, and salute.

eggs.name: Class of the Last Spring
eggs.lore: A school time capsule. Open in 100 years. It has been a little longer than that.
eggs.toast: A time capsule from a Maker school class.

doc.title: To whoever opens this
doc.body:
Hello from Class 4B! We are burying this under the playground so you can find it in 100 years. By then the robots will have cleaned everything up and there will be gardens on every roof (Mira says). We put in: one marble, a drawing of our class snail (his name is Gus), and this letter. Please water the school garden. It is the one with the yellow fence. If you are a robot, hello robot. You are doing a great job.

— Class 4B, last spring

eggs.name: High Score
eggs.lore: SWEEP-O-TRON, an arcade cabinet about a little robot cleaning up a city. The top score belongs to someone called WREN.
eggs.toast: Patch finds a coin in its compartment. SWEEP-O-TRON boots up: 'NEW CHALLENGER'.

eggs.name: Lost: Biscuit
eggs.lore: LOST CAT. Answers to Biscuit. Orange, friendly, runs on two AA batteries. Three posters, one trail.
eggs.toast: Biscuit! A little robot cat shell, curled up exactly where the posters said. It purrs.

posters.title: LOST CAT
posters.body:
LOST CAT — BISCUIT
Orange, stripy, very friendly. Purrs when you pat his head (that is his reset button). Last seen chasing a leaf toward the market.
If found please call the number on his collar. Reward: one (1) fresh-baked muffin.

posters.title: STILL LOST
posters.body:
STILL LOOKING FOR BISCUIT
Someone saw him near the old laundromat, sleeping in a warm dryer vent. He likes warm places and quiet corners.
He is a robot cat, so please don't feed him fish. He will try. It will not go well.

posters.title: LAST SEEN
posters.body:
BISCUIT WAS HERE
He sleeps in the sun on the corner by the old lot. He does not need much: a warm spot, a pat on the head, and somebody to come back.
If you find him, tell him we are sorry we had to leave.

eggs.name: The Last Can
eggs.prompt: E   give the machine a whack
eggs.lore: A FIZZ machine with exactly one can left. It has been holding it for someone who really needed it.
eggs.toast: KA-CHUNK. The machine gives up its very last can of FIZZ. SOLD OUT lights up, proudly.

eggs.name: WREN's Constellation
eggs.lore: Old Town's amateur telescope still points at the five stars the Makers called 'the Wren'. The Cradle's AI was named after them.
eggs.toast: Five stars over Old Town line up into a little bird. And next to it, faint, the letters W R E N.

eggs.name: Long Distance
eggs.lore: A payphone that rings when anything walks past. The line has been on hold for a very long time.
eggs.toast: 'Thank you for holding. Your call is important to us. Estimated wait: four hundred and twelve years.' Smooth jazz.

eggs.name: Still Broadcasting
eggs.lore: A television on a lawn chair, still tuned to the weather channel. Someone was watching the forecast when everyone left.
eggs.toast: The static clears for a second: 'TODAY: DUSTY. TOMORROW: DUSTY. OUTLOOK: ...GREEN?' Then snow again.

eggs.name: Gus
eggs.lore: A snail on top of a barrel. Class 4B's class pet was called Gus. This might be his great-great-(a lot)-grandsnail.
eggs.toast: A snail. Small, slow, unbothered. Patch decides his name is Gus.

eggs.name: Lunch Break
eggs.lore: Two old cleanup robots on a bench, waiting for the end of a lunch break the Ledger never ended.
eggs.toast: Patch leaves a small flower between the two old robots. It seems right.

eggs.name: Ding!
eggs.lore: A microwave that still beeps three times whenever someone works nearby. There is a bag of popcorn inside. It has been waiting.
eggs.toast: Inside: one bag of popcorn, three hundred years old and perfectly un-popped. Patience is a virtue.

eggs.name: Caution
eggs.lore: A WET FLOOR sign in the middle of a dry, dusty lot. Somebody, centuries ago, mopped here.
eggs.toast: CAUTION: WET FLOOR. The floor has been dry for three centuries. The sign remains cautious.

eggs.name: Being Watched
eggs.lore: One of the Ledger's old cost-saving cameras. It still swivels to follow anything that moves, and counts it.
eggs.toast: The old Ledger camera has been following Patch around. Patch waves. The red light blinks twice, flustered.

eggs.name: Tyre Tower
eggs.lore: Eight tyres, one duck. Someone balanced this as a dare and it simply never fell down.
eggs.toast: The tyre tower wobbles... wobbles... and holds. The duck on top does not even blink.
